role_token_convention: FELLOW = postdoctoral researcher/applicant (Dr. Rositsa Cholakova); HOST = beneficiary/host organisation (ELTE); SUPERVISOR = supervisor at host (Dr. András Jung); VALIDATION_PARTNER = associated partner (AgroVIR). status_vocabulary: status values are exactly the four CLAUDE.md §12.2 categories (Confirmed / Inferred / Assumed / Unresolved). All spine items and project decisions here are Confirmed; the sole Inferred item is the RQ3/RQ4 coherence caveat.

project_decisions.question: Target field state
project_decisions.decision: Root-zone soil moisture + crop water status

project_decisions.question: Ground-truth measurements
project_decisions.decision: Non-destructive physiological measurements: chlorophyll fluorescence, stomatal conductance, canopy/leaf temperature, spectral reflectance

project_decisions.question: Uncertainty-calibration criterion
project_decisions.decision: Prediction-interval coverage (90% PIs contain the truth about 90% of the time)

project_decisions.question: Pilot success
project_decisions.decision: The RQ5 calibration target is met on the validation set

project_decisions.question: Homogeneous-patch/control-stand covariation proof
project_decisions.decision: A co-located seasonal campaign measuring the target crop and the proxy patch simultaneously and showing statistical covariation

coherence_note.reasoning: RQ3 keeps root-zone soil moisture within the target field state, but the RQ4 non-destructive physiological measures validate the crop-water-status component directly and the root-zone soil-moisture component only indirectly. Recorded as a coherence caveat, not a gap; no soil-moisture sensor plan is fabricated.

summary.note: All nine spine items and all ten project decisions are operator-confirmed. The only non-Confirmed record is the RQ3/RQ4 coherence caveat (Inferred). No item remains Assumed or Unresolved.
